title: Legacy charge recorder reliability v2
objective: Directors need the charge recorder under src/ledger to record charges correctly, record outcomes, and never silently treat failures as success. Improve the existing module so production can trust recordCharge, and add tests that cover success and failure cases. Do not open a PR or deploy.

findings: Directors need the charge recorder under src/ledger to record charges correctly, record outcomes, and never silently treat failures as success. Improve the existing module so production can trust recordCharge, and add tests that cover success and failure cases. Do not open a PR or deploy.
No deterministic engineering-quality blockers in changed sources.
recordCharge currently stores only successful charges; failure cases throw errors but do not create a stored outcome entry, which means failure outcomes are not persisted.
Unit tests validate rejection of invalid inputs and duplicate IDs, but they do not assert that a failure results in a recorded outcome (e.g., a status field indicating FAIL).
The test suite covers both success and error‑raising paths, satisfying the requirement for tests that cover success and at least one failure path.
No silent‑success behavior is introduced; failures are explicitly re‑thrown rather than being swallowed.
